items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: Fissel and Buddy Mann I think they were about the oldest one in the bunch.

ctx.x: I was going to ask a little bit more about this picture. You say it was in Covington around 1921.

Right around that time. How old were you then about, you don't look very old then. No I was a kid then. I was real. I don't think I was 20 years old and that's what I was telling you about. But Buddy was older than me. Yeah. Yeah. Buddy was way older than me. And first of all, well Fissel and Buddy Mann I think they were about the oldest one in the bunch.
Buddy Mann today looks a little older than me.
